title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Reducing Unnecessary API Calls via Behavior-Aligned Retriever
abstract: arXiv:2508.14323v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tool-augmented LLMs invoke external functions to extend their capabilities, but errors in the invocation decision, such as calling a tool when none is needed or omitting a needed call, can produce unreliable outputs and unnecessary cost. A lightweight remedy is to prepend retrieved examples so LLMs decide tool use in context. However, existing retrievers rank examples by semantic similarity alone. Lexically close or semantically close queries can require opposite behavior, so the retrieved examples may be behaviorally inconsistent and silently mislead the model. We propose Behavior Aligned Retrieval (BAR), a backbone-agnostic training recipe that teaches a dense retriever a behavior-aware similarity, keeping semantically related candidates close only when their tool-use behavior is compatible. BAR does not predict invocation labels; instead, it ranks demonstrations while leaving the final tool-use decision to the LLM. Applied to mult

translated_title: 超越语义相似性：通过行为对齐检索器减少不必要的API调用
translated_abstract: 工具增强型大语言模型（LLM）通过调用外部函数来扩展其能力，但调用决策中的错误——例如在不需要工具时调用工具，或遗漏必要的调用——可能产生不可靠的输出和不必要的成本。一种轻量级的补救方法是在输入前加入检索到的示例，使LLM在上下文中决定是否使用工具。然而，现有的检索器仅根据语义相似度对示例进行排序。词汇或语义上接近的查询可能需要截然相反的工具使用行为，因此检索到的示例可能在行为上不一致，从而悄悄地误导模型。我们提出行为对齐检索（BAR），这是一种与骨干网络无关的训练方法，它教会密集检索器一种行为感知的相似度，只有当语义相关候选的工具使用行为兼容时才保持它们彼此接近。BAR并不预测调用标签；相反，它只负责对示例进行排序，而将最终的工具使用决策留给LLM。应用于多（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出行为对齐检索（BAR）训练方法，通过教会检索器行为感知的相似度来检索工具使用行为一致的示例，从而减少工具增强型LLM因示例行为不一致导致的错误API调用。
en_tdlr: Proposes Behavior Aligned Retrieval (BAR), a backbone-agnostic training recipe that teaches a dense retriever behavior-aware similarity to retrieve demonstrations with compatible tool-use behavior, thereby reducing erroneous and unnecessary API calls in tool-augmented LLMs.
